  PROBLEM: `git_subcommands` does not recognize Bash `NAME+=VALUE` prefixes, so it can treat the assignment as the executable and omit the Git invocation from guard evaluation.
  WHY: The Git write is then skipped by the pre-filter; reviewers disagreed on severity, with the highest rating retained.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1175-1189 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: After recognizing a `NAME+=VALUE` prefix, splitting it at `=` would retain `+` in the assignment name, causing the inline CDPATH source to be mislabeled.
  WHY: The `CDPATH` assignment lookup would miss the `CDPATH+` key, although the broader token check still blocks the write.

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The CDPATH redirection tests do not cover a `CDPATH+=..` prefix.
  WHY: The append-assignment bypass can pass the described unit and end-to-end test coverage.

  PROBLEM: The regex does not match Bash `NAME+=VALUE` prefixes, so `CDPATH+=.. cd target && git commit` bypasses the CDPATH guard.
  WHY: Bash applies the append assignment before `cd`, but the guard retains the original checkout directory when judging the later Git write.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 471, same regex `r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*="` in `git_subcommands` | severity=critical | confidence=5

  WHY: The pre-filter returns no subcommands, so the push is never evaluated.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py: line 1175-1178, assignment loop in `guard_targets` | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After recognizing `CDPATH+=..`, splitting on `=` would produce the key `CDPATH+`, so the inline CDPATH source detection would miss it.
  WHY: The broader token check still blocks the write, but reports that CDPATH was set earlier rather than inline.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Mark the state from any earlier word containing CDPATH" (plan implementation step 1, docs/plans/issue-6090-merge-guard-cdpath-plan.md lines 62-75). Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py — the assignment-parser loop at line 1175 and the `git_subcommands` pre-filter at line 471. Evidence of absence: Neither regex matches Bash `+=` append-assignment prefixes; the `CDPATH+=..` token is not recognized as an assignment, so the `cd` that follows it is never processed as a directory change. No test case in `test_a_cd_that_cdpath_may_redirect_makes_later_calls_unjudgeable` covers the `CDPATH+=..` form. SEVERITY: BLOCKER ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
